environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL RDS (db user: app_contact_rw with full CRUD permissions on contact_submissions table). Postfix SMTP relay on localhost:25 with no header sanitization. No input validation middleware. Node.js 18 runtime with nodemailer 6.9.x.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON contact_submissions TO app_contact_rw
config.smtp_relay: postfix localhost:25, no milter, no header_checks
